043package dev.visdb.seesaw.utils;
044
045import java.io.IOException;
046import java.lang.System.Logger;
047import java.util.ArrayList;
048import java.util.List;
049import java.util.Objects;
050import java.util.Properties;
051import java.util.regex.Matcher;
052import java.util.regex.Pattern;
053
054import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
055
056// TODO: could add isNull() method for 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT
057// TODO: could add getMajor(), ... methods
058// TODO: could handle optional "<branch>branch-name</branch> i the pom
059
060/**
061 * Version string is of the form "{@literal <digits>.<digits>.<digits>-SNAPSHOT}"
062 * where "-SNAPSHOT" is optional and missing components are 0; so 4.1 is treated
063 * as 4.1.0.
064 * <p>
065 * In addition, a version may end in {@literal -<anything>} and is
066 * considered pre-release. The pre-release string is converted to lower case.<br>
067 * For comparisons regular-release {@literal >} pre-release {@literal >} snapshot.<br>
068 * For example 1.2.3 {@literal >} 1.2.3-RC1 {@literal >} 1.2.3-SNAPSHOT.<br>
069 * For example 1.2.3-RC2 {@literal >} 1.2.3-RC1
070 * <p>
071 *
072 * {@linkplain Version} is comparable, for example,
073 * {@snippet :
074 * if (Version.get().compareTo(Version.get("4.0.11")) >= 0) {
075 *     // Do this for SwingSet version 4.0.11 and later
076 * }
077 * assert Version.get("4.0").compareTo(Version.get("4.0.0")) == 0;
078 * assert Version.get("4.0.11-SNAPSHOT").compareTo(Version.get("4.0.11")) < 0;
079 * }
080 */
081public class Version implements Comparable<Version> {
082  /** Log4j Logger for component */
083  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
084
085  /** Name of SwingSet version resource file. */
086  private final static String SS_VERSION_FILENAME = "swingsetVersion.properties";
087
088  /** Name of version key in resource file. */
089  private final static String VERSION_KEY = "version";
090
091  /** Use all zeros version if there's a parsing error. */
092  private final static String ERROR_VERSION = "0.0.0-SNAPSHOT";
093
094  /** Versions that end with this are considered snapshots. */
095  private final static String SNAP = "-SNAPSHOT";
096
097  private static Version SINGLETON;
098
099  /**
100   * Returns the singleton Version of the running SwingSet library.
101   * If the version property is not found, or there is a parse error,
102   * then 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT is used.
103   * @return version
104   */
105  public static Version get() {
106    if (SINGLETON == null) {
107      SINGLETON = parse(getVersionProperty());
108    }
109    return SINGLETON;
110  }
111
112  /**
113   * Returns the Version resulting from parsing the {@code sVer}
114   * param. If there is a parse error, then 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT is used.
115   * The return values are useful for comparing.
116   * @param sVer version string to parse
117   * @return version
118   */
119  public static Version get(String sVer) {
120    return parse(sVer);
121  }
122
123  // These three values are used to specify the type of version, used for compare
124  private static final int VER_REGULAR = 3;
125  private static final int VER_PRE_RELEASE = 2;
126  private static final int VER_SNAPSHOT = 1;
127
128  /** Version number components. */
129  private final List<Integer> versionSequence;
130  /** Is the version a snapshot? */
131  private final boolean isSnapshot;
132  private final String preRelease;
133  private final int versionType;
134
135  private Version(List<Integer> _versionSequence, boolean _isSnapshot, String _pre) {
136    versionSequence = new ArrayList<>(_versionSequence);
137    isSnapshot = _isSnapshot;
138    preRelease = _pre.toLowerCase();
139    versionType = !preRelease.isEmpty() ? VER_PRE_RELEASE : isSnapshot ? VER_SNAPSHOT : VER_REGULAR;
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Check if this release is a "-SNAPSHOT".
144   * @return true if snapshot
145   */
146  public boolean isSnapshot() {
147    return isSnapshot;
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Check if this release is a pre-release; has "-xxx" appended.
152   * @return true if pre-release
153   */
154  public boolean isPreRelease() {
155    return !preRelease.isEmpty();
156  }
157
158  /**
159   * Get the lower case pre-release string; empty if not a prerelease.
160   * @return pre-release string as lower case
161   */
162  public String preRelease() {
163    return preRelease;
164  }
165  /** {@inheritDoc} */
166  @Override
167  public int compareTo(Version o) {
168    for (int i = 0; i < versionSequence.size(); ++i) {
169      int diff = versionSequence.get(i) - o.versionSequence.get(i);
170      if (diff != 0) {
171        return diff;
172      }
173    }
174    // The 'x.y.z' parts are equal
175    if (versionType == VER_PRE_RELEASE && o.versionType == VER_PRE_RELEASE) {
176      return preRelease.compareToIgnoreCase(o.preRelease);
177    }
178    return versionType - o.versionType;
179  }
180
181  /**
182   * Parse a version string; return parse of "0.0.0-SNAPSHOT" if parse error.
183   * @param _sVer version string to parse
184   * @return An Version
185   */
186  private static Version parse(String _sVer) {
187    String sVer = _sVer != null ? _sVer : ERROR_VERSION;
188    boolean isSnap = false;
189    boolean is_error = false;
190    String pre = "";
191    if (sVer.endsWith(SNAP)) {
192      // strip off the "-SNAPSHOT"
193      sVer = sVer.substring(0, sVer.length() - SNAP.length());
194      isSnap = true;
195    }
196    int preIdx = sVer.indexOf('-');
197    if (preIdx >= 0) {
198      // remove the pre release indicator
199      if (preIdx + 1 == sVer.length() || isSnap) {
200        // a version tag of only "-" or a x.y.z-pre-SNAPSHOT
201        is_error = true;
202      } else {
203        pre = sVer.substring(preIdx + 1);
204        sVer = sVer.substring(0, preIdx);
205      }
206    }
207    if (!is_error) {
208      Matcher m = Pattern.compile("^(\\d+)(\\.(\\d+))?(\\.(\\d+))?$").matcher(sVer);
209      // group({1, 3, 5}) are the components
210      if (m.matches()) {
211        List<Integer> seq = new ArrayList<>();
212        seq.add(Integer.valueOf(m.group(1)));
213        seq.add(m.group(3) != null ? Integer.valueOf(m.group(3)) : (Integer) 0);
214        seq.add(m.group(5) != null ? Integer.valueOf(m.group(5)) : (Integer) 0);
215        return new Version(seq, isSnap, pre);
216      }
217    }
218    logger.log(ERROR, () -> "Version parse error: " + _sVer);
219    return parse(ERROR_VERSION);
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Return the SwingSet version number or null if there is an issue.
224   *
225   * @return the SwingSet version number or null if there is an issue.
226   */
227  private static String getVersionProperty() {
228    String ver = null;
229    Properties props = new Properties();
230    try {
231      props.load(Version.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(SS_VERSION_FILENAME));
232      ver = props.getProperty(VERSION_KEY);
233    } catch (IOException | NullPointerException ex) {
234      logger.log(ERROR, "Unable to load SwingSet version properties file.", ex);
235    }
236
237    return ver;
238  }
239
240  /** {@inheritDoc} */
241  @Override
242  public String toString() {
243    return versionSequence.get(0) + "." + versionSequence.get(1) + "." + versionSequence.get(2)
244        + (isSnapshot ? "-SNAPSHOT" : "") + (preRelease.isEmpty() ? "" : "-" + preRelease());
245  }
246
247  /** {@inheritDoc} */
248  @Override
249  public int hashCode() {
250    int hash = 5;
251    hash = 53 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.versionSequence);
252    hash = 53 * hash + (this.isSnapshot ? 1 : 0);
253    return hash;
254  }
255
256  /** {@inheritDoc} */
257  @Override
258  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
259    if (this == obj) {
260      return true;
261    }
262    if (obj == null) {
263      return false;
264    }
265    if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
266      return false;
267    }
268    final Version other = (Version) obj;
269    if (this.isSnapshot != other.isSnapshot) {
270      return false;
271    }
272    return Objects.equals(this.versionSequence, other.versionSequence);
273  }
274}
